input.prompt: Clean flat vector infographic for a website, square composition on a pure white background, corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, matching a light blue and yellow illustration set. Two large rounded-square panels sit side by side: the left panel with a pale blue #E7F0FB fill contains a simple screen icon with a contact card, a deal pipeline of colored bars and a handshake icon, with one large bold navy label 'CRM' beneath it; the right panel with the same pale blue fill contains a screen icon with an orders table, an invoice and a bar chart, with one large bold navy label 'ERP' beneath it. Between the two panels, two thick curved arrows in periwinkle blue form a two-way loop, one pointing right and one pointing left. Along the bottom, a row of four small rounded cards with pale blue fill, each with one simple icon and one short bold navy label: a person card labeled 'Customers', an order slip labeled 'Orders', a price tag with a stock box labeled 'Prices & Stock', an invoice with a coin labeled 'Invoices'. A small yellow spark accent sits near the top. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, navy #1F2A44, soft green check marks #3BB273, white. Generous margins, balanced spacing, crisp edges, no connecting dotted lines. The only text in the image is the six labels 'CRM', 'ERP', 'Customers', 'Orders', 'Prices & Stock', 'Invoices', all bold, correctly spelled, with clear padding inside their panels.
